findings.evidence: Mathlib `Algebra/Module/Submodule/Range.lean:381` defines `Submodule.mapIic : Submodule R P ≃o Set.Iic P`, while `Order/LatticeIntervals.lean:161` states `Set.Iic.isCompl_iff`; Mathlib itself combines these APIs at `LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:526`.
findings.fix: Express the proof through `P.mapIic.isCompl_iff` and `Set.Iic.isCompl_iff`, using `Submodule.coe_mapIic_apply` to identify mapped submodules; remove the two helper declarations and the manual injectivity scaffolding.
findings.issue: `isCompl_comap_subtype`, `sup_map_subtype_eq_of_codisjoint`, and the manual map/comap work in `isIndecomposableModule_coe_iff` duplicate the complement transport already supplied by `Submodule.mapIic` and `OrderIso.isCompl_iff`.

summary: The ambient-lattice translation reimplements Mathlib’s existing order isomorphism between submodules of P and the interval below P.
